strategy.primary: Voltron/Infect with drawback suppression: neutralise Lord's enter trigger (Torpor Orb, Karn, Dress Down, Stifle, Tale's End), give the 10/4 haste and evasion, and convert 10 power into a kill with Tainted Strike/Phyresis (+ Kediss for every opponent), Uncaged Fury or Chandra's Ignition.
strategy.secondary: Zombie/sacrifice backup: feed the trigger with recursive fodder (Gravecrawler, Reassembling Skeleton, Bloodghast) and win with Gravecrawler/Skeleton loops into Blood Artist, Zulaport Cutthroat or Goblin Bombardment.

commander_oracle_snapshots.oracle_text:

{B}: Regenerate Lord of Tresserhorn.

Recursive fodder and loop piece; Lord is its Zombie.
